description: Stage 13 held-out conversational trajectories. Written before any system was run on them and before the preregistration was committed. Independently authored from the 36 seed cases (no paraphrases), synthetic, one user per trajectory. Turn kinds: say = an ordinary committed user turn; remember = the user asked GIDEON to remember something (the app turns this into an explicit command); correct = the user corrected a remembered item (mistake or real change); forget = the user asked to forget an item. Queries run at their own time, against only the history before it. Rubric terms are case-insensitive substrings; mustInclude is a list of groups where any alternative satisfies the group.
